title: To me, health and calling in sick (Unit 6 final)
description: Unit 6 check after lessons 5, 6 and 7, with the unit's final task.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Yesterday I didn't have time.
items.explanation: Review (Unit 5): haben in the past: ich hatte.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with mögen: I don't like fish.
Fill in the gap: I'm happy to help you. (to one friend)
items.explanation: helfen takes the dative: du becomes dir.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Does the phone belong to you? (polite)
items.explanation: gehören takes the dative: Sie becomes Ihnen.

items.question: Which sentence means 'I like the city'? (with gefallen)
items.explanation: The city does the pleasing; the person is in the dative: mir.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: My feet hurt.
items.explanation: die Füße is plural, so tun: Mir tun die Füße weh.

items.question: Which one means 'I have a stomach ache'?

items.audio: Nehmen Sie die Tabletten dreimal am Tag nach dem Essen.
items.question: When do you take the tablets?
items.explanation: nach dem Essen = after meals, three times a day.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: How long have you had a temperature?
items.explanation: Seit wann ...? = Since when ...? / How long ...?

items.text: Ich bin leider krank und kann heute nicht kommen.
items.explanation: leider = unfortunately; kann ... kommen: the verb bracket.

items.question: You're writing to an office and don't know who will read it. How do you start?
items.explanation: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren when you don't know the name.

items.instruction: Unit 6 final task, in two parts. Part 1: you're ill. Write an email to your boss or your teacher in 5-6 sentences: a greeting, what's wrong (Mir tut ... weh / Ich habe ...), that you can't come today, that you're going to the doctor, and a closing. Part 2: a colleague visits you for the first time. In 3-4 sentences, explain the way from the U-Bahn to your door (aussteigen, geradeaus, links, rechts, an der Ampel ...). Claude will check it. Then ask Claude for the live role-play: calling in sick by phone, and giving the directions.
items.prompt: Part 1: call in sick by email. Part 2: the way from the U-Bahn to your door.
